scope: Package consumer gate only; no production, dependency declaration, lockfile or preservation-ledger changes.

red.reason: ENOTCACHED for the immutable codeload Git artifact in an empty disposable cache; same-name direct file tgz cannot satisfy Rector Git edge.

guardChecks: Full immutable Git commit in actual Rector tarball manifest
Published Git declaration equals project lock root edge
Locked resolved commit matches published commit
Packed Git artifact name/version match lock
Installed Rector manifest and lock preserve original Git edge
Consumer has no direct same-name override
Resolved Git URL/version match original lock and are not a link
Actual installed Git package export targets exist

commandPolicy.staging: npm pack <exact published Git spec> --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination <temporary Git artifacts> --cache <disposable cache>
commandPolicy.consumer: npm install --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --cache <same disposable cache> <unaltered Rector tgz> <registry dependency tgz files only>
